correctness.rationale: Explicit exterior-product normal forms after linear conjugation exhaust every unital idempotent endomorphism, with fixed-projection lift counts 1,q^3,q^4,1 and linear projection counts. Image classification follows from generator normal forms, pair equivalence by adding multiples of xy, explicit automorphism extension, and canonical-image fiber enumeration. Standard-library checker exhaustively verifies all coefficient choices for each canonical tangent projection over F3, separately checks rank-one and rank-two image distinctness and fibers, and tests rank-two normal forms over F5/F7. Finite tests supplement the arbitrary odd prime-power proof.

value.rationale: The full idempotent-endomorphism image/fiber stratification is a natural endomorphism-monoid invariant for a fundamental finite noncommutative algebra. The first three-generator case has genuine nonlinear even-degree and cubic terms, equal numbers of images of dimensions 2 and 4, and distinct q^2/q^3 multiplicities. This is a complete, reproducible count over all odd prime powers, not an arbitrary single instance or restatement of automorphism-group facts.
